lesson.meaning: A person who takes part in an activity, event, or discussion.
examples: All participants in the training workshop received a certificate.
We need to ensure every participant feels comfortable sharing their ideas during the meeting.
The survey asked participants for their feedback on the new company policy.
There were over 100 participants in the charity run this year.
As a key participant in the project, you'll be responsible for several important tasks.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'participate' – a participant is someone who 'participates' or takes part! They are an active part of something.
